title: Pointwise finite coefficient ring maps on the pro-etale site
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $R,S$ be finite rings, not necessarily commutative, with their discrete topologies, and let $\phi:R\to S$ be a unital ring homomorphism. Use the coefficient presheaves $P_R,P_S$ and coefficient ring sheaves $R_T,S_T$ on the small pro-etale site of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. Define the presheaf morphism $P_\phi:P_R\to P_S$ at each object $U\to T$ by pointwise composition $s\mapsto\phi\circ s$ on $\operatorname{Cont}(\pi_0(|U|),R)$. Its component is a unital ring homomorphism, and it commutes with restrictions because those are precomposition. Define $\phi_T:R_T\to S_T$ to be the image of $P_\phi$ under ring-valued sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification].
